quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「處置與重新驗證」。離線測試需真正停用網路且重新載入；不能僅因install事件完成就宣告全站離線可用。 與本階段判準一起判讀：兩版共存需1360 KiB教學預算；完整切換後760 KiB。失敗安裝不得宣稱B已可離線。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies disposition and re-verification. Test offline with networking disabled and a reload; an install event does not prove complete offline operation. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Coexistence needs the 1360 KiB fixture budget; after transition 760 remains. A failed install cannot claim B is offline-ready.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Service Worker: offline caches and version transitions — Establish the contract and baseline and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付cache-manifest.csv、舊客戶端切換紀錄與可回復的版本策略。
在交接件中加入「Service Worker：離線快取與版本切換 — 建立契約與基準」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：兩版共存需1360 KiB教學預算；完整切換後760 KiB。失敗安裝不得宣稱B已可離線。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：建立每版cacheName與URL清單，模擬安裝成功、下載一檔失敗與離線開啟三種路徑。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver cache-manifest.csv, old-client transition traces and a reversible version policy.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Service Worker: offline caches and version transitions — Establish the contract and baseline: Coexistence needs the 1360 KiB fixture budget; after transition 760 remains. A failed install cannot claim B is offline-ready.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Define cache names and URL lists; simulate complete install, one failed asset and offline opening. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。兩版共存需1360 KiB教學預算；完整切換後760 KiB。失敗安裝不得宣稱B已可離線。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Coexistence needs the 1360 KiB fixture budget; after transition 760 remains. A failed install cannot claim B is offline-ready.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.

steps.checkEn: Coexistence needs the 1360 KiB fixture budget; after transition 760 remains. A failed install cannot claim B is offline-ready.

knowledge.text: 以「Service Worker：離線快取與版本切換」研究公開標準或代表性軟體系統。建立每版cacheName與URL清單，模擬安裝成功、下載一檔失敗與離線開啟三種路徑。 本課所有數值、事件序列與驗收預算為明示教學fixture；官方文件支援機制，不是本課工作負載的實測規格。
knowledge.textEn: Study the published standard or representative system in Service Worker: offline caches and version transitions. knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: install、waiting與activate不是同一時刻；新worker與舊頁面並存時必須避免不相容資源混用。
knowledge.textEn: Install, waiting and activate occur at different times; new workers and old clients can coexist, requiring compatible resource versions.
